# Praetorium

An independent, open-source shipboard command platform in development for Elite Dangerous, based on Elite Nexus by CMDR Alka Uruskan and contributors. The current native desktop foundation supports journal monitoring and local gameplay views. Production updates, outbound uploads and hosted AI are disabled.

- Source and project status: https://github.com/Shadowgar/EliteNexus-Gen2
- Original Elite Nexus project: https://github.com/uruskan/EliteNexus
